title: File:Liquid nitrogen cooling (liqu nitrogen fill dec2004).tiff
desc: The CCD detectors in the FORS instrument are kept very cold using liquid Nitrogen, in order to minimize the adverse effect of the heat during very long exposures. Without this cooling, it would not be possible to take images lasting more than a second.
